outcome_intro: Ask your AI about CloudAlly SaaS backup for Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace: the latest backup status of every customer, one customer's backup tasks and their entities, running or pausing backups, users, billing and restore jobs, all through CloudAlly's Management API v2 from one CLI and MCP server.

instead_of_say.instead: Clicking into every customer account in the partner portal to look for red backup statuses
instead_of_say.say: Show me the latest backup status of every mailbox and site across all my CloudAlly customers.

instead_of_say.instead: Opening one customer in the portal to see which backup tasks they have and whether any are paused
instead_of_say.say: Switch to this customer and list their backup tasks.

instead_of_say.instead: Paging through a task's entities in the portal to find the one that stopped backing up
instead_of_say.say: What state is every mailbox on this backup task in, and when did each last back up?

pain_points: Spotting a failing backup means opening every customer account in the CloudAlly partner portal.
The Management API v2 needs a client-id and client-secret header plus a bearer token on every request, and separate logins for partner and company scope.
Acting inside one customer from a partner login needs a token minted for that account, and tokens expire.
The documented export call answers 200 with an empty body and creates no job, so a script that trusts it reports downloads that never happen.

different_vs_wrappers: [cloudally](https://github.com/jancotanis/cloudally) (a Ruby gem) and [n8n-nodes-cloudally](https://github.com/davejlong/n8n-nodes-cloudally) (n8n workflow nodes) wrap CloudAlly's documented API. This one is a single binary that works as a CLI and an MCP server over the whole Management API v2. It handles the company and partner logins, refreshes tokens on its own, switches into a customer account with `auth use-account`, and can mirror the read endpoints into a local SQLite store for offline search.
different_vs_vendor: The CloudAlly partner portal shows one customer at a time. This works from the AI agent you already use, answers backup status across every customer in one call, and previews any change with --dry-run before it is sent.

faqs.a: Yes, on paid ChatGPT plans. ChatGPT connects to remote MCP servers over HTTPS, and cloudally-mcp speaks HTTP natively: set CLOUDALLY_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN, run `cloudally-mcp --transport http`, and serve its /mcp endpoint (http://127.0.0.1:7777/mcp by default) over HTTPS behind an authenticating proxy that signs ChatGPT in with OAuth and adds the bearer header the server requires. ChatGPT cannot send a fixed bearer token, so a bare tunnel gets HTTP 401. Step-by-step in the install guide.

faqs.q: Do I need to know how to code?
faqs.a: No. Paste one sentence into Claude Code or Codex and your agent does the install, or run a one-line installer. You enter the CloudAlly API client id and secret once and run `cloudally-cli auth login --partner`.

A CloudAlly API application key pair (CLOUDALLY_CLIENT_ID and CLOUDALLY_CLIENT_SECRET, from the partner portal under Integrations > REST API) plus one login: `auth login` for a single company account, or `auth login --partner` for every customer. The distributor and reseller commands and `auth use-account` need the partner login.

faqs.q: Can it change or delete my customers' backups?
faqs.a: It can, because CloudAlly's API can: restores write back into live mailboxes, and deleting a backup task deletes its data. Every command takes --dry-run to show the request first, and governance.md lists the destructive commands an agent should never run on its own. Set CLOUDALLY_MCP_READ_ONLY=1 to give an MCP agent read-only tools.

Your data stays on your machine. The CLI, MCP server and local store are all local, and the MCP server runs over stdio unless you start it with --transport http. Credentials are never bundled or transmitted by MSP Skills.

Not reliably. The documented export call (recovery export and its distributor and reseller variants) answers 200 with an empty body and creates no job on the live API (seen 2026-10-15). Use the CloudAlly portal for downloads.
Free. Apache-2.0 licensed. You pay only for whichever AI agent you already use.

governance_summary: This connector can start restores into live customer mailboxes and, through CloudAlly's own API, delete backup tasks and their data, so it is not read-only. Every command previews with --dry-run, and CLOUDALLY_MCP_READ_ONLY=1 limits an MCP agent to reads. The company login (auth login) reaches one customer; the partner login reaches all of them.

safety_tiers.examples: every list, get, details, status, bills, tasks and backup-statuses read; sync, search, export. Local writes only: the response cache, the local store and files you name
backup-now, activate, pause, add-entity and cancel on backup tasks; creating accounts, resellers and users; updating settings and permissions
the recovery restore commands, which write backed-up items back into live mailboxes, sites and drives

tasks delete and its distributor and reseller variants (delete a backup task and its data; use cancel to stop a job), remove-entity, unsubscribe and user delete (delete a CloudAlly account), delete-user
auth login, auth use-account, auth set-token, auth logout, session login and refresh, access-token and sign-in-token, user update-password, import
--deliver webhook:<url> on any command, feedback --send, and feedback when CLOUDALLY_FEEDBACK_ENDPOINT is set with CLOUDALLY_FEEDBACK_AUTO_SEND=true
safety_tiers.policy: Human-in-the-loop - a webhook sink moves client data off your machine

safety_tiers.examples: cloudally_execute calls any endpoint of the CloudAlly spec by ID: each call follows the tiers above, and every non-GET call is refused while CLOUDALLY_MCP_READ_ONLY=1

auth_note: Create an API application in the CloudAlly partner portal (Integrations > REST API), set CLOUDALLY_CLIENT_ID and CLOUDALLY_CLIENT_SECRET, set CLOUDALLY_PARTNER_EMAIL and CLOUDALLY_PARTNER_PASSWORD, then run `cloudally-cli auth login --partner` and `cloudally-cli doctor`: it makes one authenticated read to confirm the token works. For a single company, set CLOUDALLY_EMAIL and CLOUDALLY_PASSWORD and run `cloudally-cli auth login` instead.
